label: TP
reason: User input from HTTP header flows directly into XPath expression via concatenation at line 70 (/Employees/Employee[@emplid='" + bar + "']]') without effective sanitization. Although XXE prevention is enabled, this does not protect against XPath injection. The encodeForHTML call only appears in the exception handler (line 84) and never protects the actual XPath expression used.

evidence.note: XPath expression concatenates decoded user input 'bar' directly into XPath query
